topics.title: Preserve managed agent mentions during relay errors

entries.title: Preserve managed agent mentions during relay errors
entries.rationale: Accepted as a fail-closed mention authorization resilience fix. Preserve fresh managed evidence when unrelated relay discovery fails, while retaining strict relay-only rejection and required owner proof.
security_reasons: relay errors must not turn stale or missing agent evidence into authorization
managed-agent and relay-only evidence have different trust requirements
owner proof and revocation behavior must remain fail closed
message publication must preserve only selected authorized p tags

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated mention authorization threat review, relay-error/revocation tests, dependency screening, Zion branding checks, compatibility checks, and desktop gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, admission/revalidation logic, signed-event Playwright regression, changed unit tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
